reviews.transcript_full: I clearly remember my sixth birthday spent at the orphanage. Make a wish. It will surely come true. I hope to find my parents. When I woke up, my wish had miraculously come true. Back then, I didn't understand what time travel was. Or parallel worlds, but from then on, I had a family. Twelve years passed, but I discovered this world... Seems to hide a massive secret. Oh no, oh no! I'm gonna be late! Ah! Uncle, are you okay? They're monsters! Run! They'll eat you! Wh-what do you mean? Monsters? Man-eating monsters! Run! What was that? Where'd it go? Did I imagine it? Quick, this way! Remember, don't trust any— Ah! Don't be scared, kid. You're safe now. Quick, take him away. What... is going on? This guy escaped from a mental asylum. Extremely dangerous. Glad you're okay. Wait... Hey! What are you doing? There... There was definitely something here just now. It's... a cat. Come on, kid. I'll take you back to school. Don't overthink it. It's over now. Ah, okay. Thanks, officer. Monsters... Do monsters... really exist in this world? I remember years ago, when Grandpa passed away... I vaguely saw something that night. I heard strange beastly growls... coming from Grandpa's room. The next day, my parents told me Grandpa was gone. I was too young then, thinking it was just a nightmare. GaoYang, stand up now! Ah! What's the answer to question three? Ahahaha! Crap, caught again. WeiWei. Heh, teacher, the answer is C. Hmph. During exams... LiWeiwei can give you the answers? You two— Stay after school to clean the classroom and toilets. WeiWei, I'm sorry for dragging you into this. It's nothing. You've always taken care of me since we were kids. This time, let's call it sharing hardships, GaoYang. The news about you being attacked by a psycho this morning has spread everywhere. If you're feeling down, don't bottle it up. Remember, you've got me. WeiWei, I... WeiWei and I grew up together. I've always had feelings for her, but it's never been brought up. She's always been there for me when I needed her the most. Ahem, what are you doing? This is QingLing. WeiWei's best friend and a sprinting prodigy. Also the school's undisputed goddess. QingLing, you... what brings you here? Finished training. WeiWei, the homeroom teacher seems to be looking for you. Go to his office. Okay, I'll go now. Heard you ran into a psycho today. You okay? I'm fine, but my new bike got wrecked. Just bought it and already crashed. Looks like you were scared out of your wits. No wonder you spaced out in class. And got punished with WeiWei. I... GaoYang. Tell me about that psycho incident. I'm into supernatural stuff. Very interested. QingLing, what's up with her? Usually so aloof, but today... If you're confused, you can talk to me too. I care about you. I... Could she... like me? QingLing. You're WeiWei's best friend. We grew up together. I... You what? Hmm? QingLing. Back so soon? The teacher wasn't in his office. What did he want me for? Probably to remind you guys not to forget cleaning the restroom. That's it? Made me go all the way for this. Seriously. You guys carry on. I'm off. Lucky WeiWei didn't see. After the picnic on Saturday, we can catch an outdoor movie. Heard there's even a claw machine there. Who... who's there? Huh? What's wrong? It's just a crow. GaoYang, are you okay? You've been spacing out all day. I'm sorry, WeiWei. I... Seeing you so troubled makes me sad too. WeiWei, I have some terrifying suspicions. I think there are monsters around us. Their arms are covered in grayish-blue scales. Those scales look like tiny bugs crowded together. They seem alive, wriggling and squirming. It's like they're always watching me. Watching everything around them. Oh my god. Sometimes I think it's all just my imagination. That my memories are playing tricks on me. But everything feels so vivid. WeiWei. I know what I'm saying sounds unbelievable. You don't have to believe me, but no matter what happens. You have to protect yourself. I believe you. GaoYang, I believe every word you say. I believe you saw the monster's arm. Look, is this what it looks like? Wei... WeiWei. GaoYang. You're the first awakened one I've met. I'll never forget you. How could this be? Hahaha. My consciousness is fading. Am I dying? That's... What is that? I think I saw it when I crossed over. System awaiting activation. Activate? Do I need to touch it? This is the only way to survive. Damn it, I can't reach it. Your beating heart is so delicious, so tempting. It's perfect. I like you, GaoYang. I love you. I want to eat you bite by bite. Is that okay? You want me to be happy too, right? Fine, but don't squeeze too hard. If I die, I won't be fresh anymore. Fair point. Ah, now's the time. Yah! System activated. Loading user information. Loading complete. Are you a system or a cheat? Tell me quick, what can I use? Your Lucky Talent is a passive attribute and cannot be used directly. Ugh, then what good are you? I'm about to die! Save me, quick! Access terminated. System concealed. Damn it, what's wrong with this world? Why does it have to be WeiWei? I don't get it. I can't accept this. Ah! Wh-what's happening? Ah! I-I'm not dead? Why... you... you're mine. Ah! WeiWei! Hmph. QingLing, is... is this your superpower? Don't ask anything. Go home now. I've already disabled the nearby surveillance. Everything that happened tonight has nothing to do with you. Got it? But— I'm asking you, got it? G-got it. It... has nothing to do with me. Good. Am I dreaming? Why does everything feel so real? WeiWei is a monster. But she grew up with me... Could it be— Was everything between us fake? I can't figure it out. What's wrong with this world? Who's there? It's you! Ah! Tell me! What's wrong with WeiWei? Did she mutate? Or was it some new zombie virus? Shut up. Wh-what are you trying to do? Again? She was acting weird at school too... What does she even want? Answer me—do you like men or women? W-women. Fine. Then let's go. Wait, go where? What else? Stop playing innocent. Th-this is moving faster than a porno! This looks like a trap no matter how I see it. No, no, no way! You're pretty guarded. But a man can't say 'no way.' How about this? If you hate me, just imagine someone else's face. I don't mind. Ah! Who can resist this? She's seducing me on purpose to lower my guard. Is QingLing one of those monsters too? Did she save me just to have me all to herself? Wait, no. She could've just attacked me directly... There's no need for this. QingLing, stop messing around. I can feel it. There's a reaction. No kidding. Enough. What the hell are you doing? Wait... Did you just try to kill me? It's up to you. If you don't react, you die. Ah! Beasts don’t have real reproductive systems. Hey! Be careful! Ah! What exactly are these beasts you’re talking about? WeiWei, what’s going on? What you encountered today is a Rage Beast. There are many types of beasts. This is just one of them. They’re good at disguising themselves, blending in right beside you. This is a special medicine. It speeds up wound healing. There’s medicine like this? QingLing? Explain it to me again. Running so fast. Seems like this world hides many secrets. WeiWei’s dead. Really dead. What’s the deal with these beasts? And why did I end up in a world like this? What’s the point of that system talent anyway? Tsk, sigh. Forget it. What I should worry about now is... How to avoid police suspicion tomorrow. I heard something happened last night. Who was it? Seems like it was Li Weiwei. It’s this late and she’s still not here. Oh no... GaoYang, where’s Li Weiwei? I... I don’t know. Didn’t you two go back together yesterday? She’s not answering calls or texts. It’s almost late and she’s still not here. What’s going on? She saved me last night and told me to keep quiet. Now she’s interrogating me nonstop. Is she trying to make me clear my own suspicion? Ah! We went home separately last night. It’s weird she’s still not here. It is a bit strange. I need to tell everyone something today. Our classmate Li Weiwei was killed. What? We were together yesterday. How is that possible? Calm down, both of you. It seems Li Weiwei encountered a robber... and was tragically killed. It’s my fault. I should’ve walked her home. It’s all my fault. How could this happen? We must catch the culprit. Alright, class. Stop discussing for now, QingLing. GaoYang, both of you, go to my office now. The police have some questions for you. Ah. Yes. QingLing, let's get our stories straight. What stories? What do you mean? Stop pretending. It's just the two of us now. Who's pretending? You're really suspicious. You didn't even take WeiWei home last night. I bet this whole thing has something to do with you. I'm reporting you to the police. What's wrong with this guy? So weird. Officer Huang, I want to report this guy. Ah, report? Classmate GaoYang? Come with me first. Oh. What's going on here? Is QingLing trying to pin everything on me? GaoYang, don't be nervous. I'm just asking casually. By the way, how did you get hurt on your face? The officer's questions seem casual, but they're actually probing me. Need to be careful with my answers. Oh, uh, got bitten by a bug. Yeah, there have been a lot of bugs lately. Classmate GaoYang. The deceased, Li Weiwei, was your childhood friend. I heard she even stood up for you in class. Seems like you two were close. She had feelings for you. More accurately, she liked you, right? Maybe. Now I can't tell if that was affection. Or just twisted desire. Then I have a question. After you finished cleaning duty last night, you walked a long way together. You were already close to her house, but strangely, you didn't accompany her for the last stretch. Explain that, Classmate GaoYang. WeiWei didn't want me to walk her the last part. Said she didn't want her family to see and nag her. WeiWei's family was very strict. Even though we were close, it's still senior year. Her family wanted her to focus on studies. This reason shouldn't have any flaws. I see. That makes sense, I guess. Officer Huang, if I had insisted on walking her, would WeiWei still be alive? Life is full of accidents. Many things are unavoidable. Seems he somewhat believes me, but not entirely. Officer Huang, what about the surveillance footage? It should be easy to find the culprit. To be honest, the surveillance on the road where you separated just happened to be broken. Luckily, QingLing handled the aftermath. What a coincidence, right after we separated. Pointing out the doubts and distancing yourself should reduce suspicion. Sigh, so I think it's premeditated. It's likely someone familiar, but no leads—not even the weapon or the suspect can be identified. Let's call it a day for now. My condolences—cry if you need to. Don't hold it in. Ah, thank you, officer. But I can't cry. To survive, I have to stay calm through everything. Even locking away my feelings for WeiWei in the deepest corner of my heart. I wish this were just a nightmare. WeiWei... But this nightmare feels too real. WeiWei, which one is the real you? The quiet, shy girl, or that monster-like beast? Someone, tell me the answer. Hey, come here. QingLing. What did the police ask you? Just time, place, stuff. He probably doesn’t suspect me. But you, shouting about reporting me this morning— wasn’t that overacting? Oh, you’ve met her. Her? What do you mean? My other personality. You have split personality? No wonder you were acting weird this morning. To survive in this world, I even have to deceive myself. Over time, a second personality emerged. She’s my sister. QingLing is mostly me, but sometimes she disobeys and comes out on her own. Uh, can I trust what you’re saying? Who else would you trust? Do you know how many beasts are in this city? The ratio is one in ten thousand. One beast in every ten thousand people. But— why did it have to be WeiWei? No, one human in every ten thousand beasts. No way—one human in every ten thousand beasts? I don’t believe it. Your family, friends, neighbors— 99.9% of the people you’ve met in your life. If nothing goes wrong, they're all beasts. Meeting me was an extremely rare event for you. My family, friends, neighbors—almost everyone. They're all beasts. No, no—if everyone around me were beasts, I would've been dead long ago as a human. Because you've never noticed their existence before this. Beasts don't harm unawakened humans. They only kill the awakened. People like us. Why? Who knows? They seem to follow a self-governing set of rules. I don't have much information myself. Hey, what are you guys talking about? What are these 'beasts' you mentioned? Oh no. He's been eavesdropping outside the door this whole time. If he alerts the others, we stand no chance. If most people are beasts, running away won't do us any good. Exposing ourselves means certain death. Why so quiet? Discussing something I shouldn't hear? What do we do? Officer Huang, what are you doing here? Still working on Li Weiwei's case? Tried investigating through her connections, but after questioning everyone, still found nothing. By the way, what's this about 'beasts' and 'rules'? Sounds really interesting. Qing Ling, this is— No, if we resist, none of us will escape. Looks like we'll have to improvise. Oh, Officer Huang, you must be talking about 'Age of Monsters,' right? That's a really old survival game. Weiwei loved it as a kid. She even dragged me into playing it with her. Yeah, we were just reminiscing about Weiwei's favorite things. Oh, a game? Young people should cherish their gaming days. Won't have that luxury later. Whew. Felt like a spy thriller for a second there. Scared me to death. Don't celebrate yet. There are two possibilities now: Officer Huang is a Rage Beast—he's already suspicious and testing us. Or two, he's a Delusion Beast. Rage Beasts and Delusion Beasts. Rage Beasts are bloodthirsty and greedy—you've seen that firsthand. Delusion Beasts are special. Also called 'the Lost,' they genuinely believe they're human, fooling even themselves. They won't harm the awakened. They usually ignore critical information, rewriting their logic and memories. If Officer Huang is a Delusion Beast, then we're safe. But I wouldn't bet on it. Rage Beasts crave their prey obsessively. If I can have the Awakened all to myself, I'll never share. There are over a hundred people in the mourning hall. There must be more than one Wrath Beast. Officer Huang, are you trying to hog it all for yourself? There's still a chance to silence them permanently. At first, I refused the idea of silencing them. But if QingLing fails, I'm as good as dead. Might as well go all out. QingLing, can I ask you something? Go ahead. Other than me, do you have any other companions? I awakened ten years ago. Met two others during that time. Both died. Ten years ago... you were eight. So young, yet carrying such terrifying survival pressure. You've always been alone. Two. And my little sister. Get ready. Officer Huang's off duty. We're really doing this. By the way, what's your talent? Huh? All Awakened have talents. What's yours? Uh... seems like a passive one. Totally lame. Hold on. Hey, System, come out! What the heck is this weak talent even good for? Welcome. You've survived 43 hours so far. Gained 43 Luck Points. Allocate them now? What does allocating do? Boosts base stats. Hell yes, boost them! Base stats increased. Don't feel any different. Hidden panel triggered. Unlock? Unlock, unlock! Hurry, I need to get stronger! Insufficient luck. Then why even mention it?! Session ended. System hidden. QingLing, about this talent... Sigh. Never counted on you anyway. Go out and stop him. Say something random to distract him. Leave the rest to me. Tch. This damn 'Lucky' talent. Calls it luck, but it's useless. Just makes things worse. Officer Huang! Huh? You— It's me. I just remembered some clues I wanted to share. Great! Tell me quick. Hmm... kid. Seems you came prepared. Officer Huang, what do you mean? Hmph. Quit hiding. Come out. Don't underestimate me. Ah, the real battle begins now. Hey, throwing knives, GaoYang. You're not the only one, are you? You fell for it. I was just waiting for you to attack and reveal an opening. Pretty quick reflexes. Tch. I've won the shooting championship five years in a row. The next shot— Can you dodge it? You can try. Ah, didn't expect Officer Huang to be this tough. QingLing missed the first strike. It's already hard to get close. No matter how fast her blade is— it can't outpace a bullet. And the gunshots are too loud. If other beasts are drawn here, we're done for. Wait, it seems— the wind's picking up. As long as visibility is blocked, QingLing— now's the time. Huh? What? Crap, missed. Ugh. Die! You... you're not a rage beast. Ah, what? Officer Huang isn't a rage beast? How did you know? If you were a rage beast, at the last second— you'd have used your arms to block my attack, not a gun. Beasts are confident in their bodies. So they'd use their bodies to block. Only humans rely on things they think are sturdy. Sigh. Yeah, I'm an Awakener too. Thanks for holding back. This is the first time I've been pushed this far. Officer Huang, you really tricked us good. Officer Huang's here. Oh, and with two little lackeys too. Ah. Eating together feels great. Never thought in my life— I'd get to share a meal with two Awakeners. Ah, Officer Huang, are you crazy? How could you say that in public? Whew, that's hot! Chill, old man's a Lost One. He automatically tunes out what he doesn't want to hear. Old Man Liu, did you hear what we said? Huh? What? A beer? Yeah, beer. Relax now? Oh, right. Almost forgot. Besides rage beasts— there are also Lost Ones. Sigh. So now— we can finally have a proper talk, Officer Huang. You led us there today to test us. Just wanted to see what you're made of. Didn't expect— your girlfriend to be an Awakener too. Almost went too far. Not my girlfriend. Ugh. Sigh. Remember that mentally ill person I killed the other day? Ah, how could I forget? It's all because of him. That's why things turned out this way. He's also an Awakener. His talent... should be the ability to detect other Awakeners around him. But he's already exposed and recognized your identity. I was afraid you'd get dragged into it, so I had to shoot him to put him out of his misery. Oh, thanks. We're all in the same boat. It's the least I could do. Hey, if none of you are eating, just give it all to me. The topic's so heavy... QingLing, all you think about is food. Where are your manners? Haha. Officer Huang, tell us more about talents. Ah, want to know about talents? No problem. Let me give you a proper explanation. Once a human awakens, they immediately gain a talent. Talents can also be acquired through later comprehension. But the methods and patterns of comprehension are unpredictable. Take QingLing's talents as an example. QingLing... should possess Sequence 32, the Blade God. and Sequence 20, the Metal talent. Teacher Huang, how did you know that? Ah, great question. During our sparring... I noticed she could control flying daggers, so I guessed the Metal talent. Plus, her sword skills and overwhelming destructive power... could only mean the Blade God talent. Teacher, you know so much. Enough flattery. I have a question. How many talents are there in total? Current intel suggests 199, theoretically. The lower the sequence number, the stronger the talent. So... our QingLing here is quite exceptional. GaoYang, what's wrong? Sigh, then my Sequence 199, Luck, must be the weakest. I'm doomed. Absolutely doomed. Give me the talent sequence list. This system is such a scam. I can tell you all the talents beyond Sequence 50... and even... throw in one crucial piece of info. But in exchange, you have to help me kill someone. Officer Huang, killing is illegal. To be precise, help me kill a beast. A beast? How are we supposed to fight those monsters? Just follow my instructions. I guarantee... you'll be perfectly safe. If things get too dangerous... just abort immediately. We're all orphans in this world... long abandoned by it. To survive in this world surrounded by beasts, you need stronger talents and mastery, as well as more useful information. Give me your answer now. I agree. I agree too. Officer Huang saved me before, he's trustworthy. And to survive in this cruel world, we must actively grasp more clues. Remember, after self-study tomorrow night, open them in order. But don’t let your guard down. Reborn in such a hell, you could die at any moment. Ah, QingLing said to meet around here. Where is she? Here, change into the school uniform. Ah, change clothes? You... again? Can’t you be more considerate? Stop talking and hurry up. How much farther? According to the first note, it’s right beneath us nearby. Hmm, hold me. What? Blend into the environment. Ah, okay. You smell so nice, and your body is so soft. A little chubby. The first note says: under the east side of Qingqiao Bridge. Use your metal talent to find something. This is the spot. Found it, but it’s a bit far. Come here, hold me. Ahaha, I’m just a tool, huh? Fine. How should I hold you? Like Titanic. Got it, director. This scene feels a bit romantic. Hey, too tight. Here, the second mission location. Why is it a love hotel again? Help me up. Ahem, check-in. A room on the fifth floor, south-facing window. Any available? What a coincidence, only one room left—Mirror Flower Water Moon, with an automatic waterbed. For an ultimate experience. This one, hurry up. Please show your ID, GaoYang. You actually sneaked here behind my back? Oh no, WangZikai, what are you doing here? I should be asking you that. How could you end up in a hotel with QingLing? I just lost five games in a row at the internet cafe next door. As soon as I came out, I saw you two acting suspiciously. Spill it. What are you doing here? Confess, and you’ll be treated leniently. What else do people do at a hotel? Get a room, obviously. Yeah, yeah, yeah, get a room. What? You, this idiot, actually came to a hotel with the school’s goddess? This is crazier than Viktor maxing W on Maokai or Lee Sin flashing R to save a minion. Look me in the eyes. Your childhood sweetheart LiWeiwei just left a few days ago, her funeral isn’t even over yet. Is this appropriate? You’re such a beast. Heh heh heh. Ignore him, let’s go upstairs. Uh, WangZikai. I’ll explain later. This kid’s grown wings. Not only did he get a girlfriend, but he’s actually doing it. Why? I can accept not having a girlfriend. But there’s no way GaoYang gets one before me. Tell me, which room did they get? This— That’s the guest’s privacy. Spit it out. Or I’ll make your private parts disappear, got it, bro? 501, 501. Get me room 601 right now. Right away, yes, yes. WangZikai is a problem. It’s fine, right? He probably didn’t notice anything. You’re thinking too simply. WangZikai already knows we came here to get a room. It’ll probably spread at school. We’re a close couple—we have to make sure there are no flaws. Uh. Ah. Mm, QingLing. Don’t move, let the cameras catch this. This is my first kiss. Mine too. What’s next? What couples do when they get a room, we’ll do. Ah, a text from WangZikai. This— Hmm, WangZikai is right. I need to stay calm. Desire is emptiness, lay down the butcher’s knife, attain enlightenment—I need to stay calm. I’m taking a shower. What The devil is always a step ahead. Do you want to go wash up too? Witch! Don't even think about destroying my cultivation! How many of those things do you usually use? What things? What do you mean by 'how many'? QingLing, no need to take the act too seriously. I didn't say to take it seriously. Just make sure all traces are plausible. Leave no loopholes. Whew, scared me to death. I'm not mentally prepared yet. GaoYang, looking at your hesitant state... Seems like you still don't get one thing. What? What thing? Wake up. Your old life is gone. You must quickly adapt to the new rules in this hell. Abandon meaningless thoughts. Disguise yourself shamelessly. Struggle desperately to survive. Otherwise, there's only one outcome—death. Never thought... I'd share a bed with QingLing. Just to hide from the beasts everywhere. Yeah. Everything from the past is destroyed. QingLing, time to move. Already awake. Let's go. Yeah, everything we do now... is just to survive. Good visibility, wind speed about 1.2 meters per second. Got it. Who to kill? See for yourself. Kill the woman beside him. Officer Huang is also there. He sent us to assassinate her. To completely clear his own suspicion, right? This 'kill with a borrowed knife' tactic... Target spotted. Let me see. This woman... Officer Huang wants her dead. Looks like his wife. Most likely, his wife suspected his Awakener identity. That's why Officer Huang decided to use us... to eliminate her. Our lives... seem predestined. reviews.transcript_excerpt:

captions.text:
additional forms of entertainment

reviews.transcript_full:
For most passengers, long-haul flights are 
a matter of endurance aided by a few drinks,   inflight entertainment, and trying to get some 
sleep between meal services. It is an entirely   different matter for the people flying the plane 
as there are still plenty of things to do even   after takeoff. Let’s look at what’s happening 
on the flight deck during these longer flights… Even though flight paths are decided upon 
before departure, pilots have to monitor   weather conditions and decide whether 
or not to alter them during the flight.   On long-haul flights, weather conditions are 
more likely to change from initial forecasts,   with aircraft often encountering multiple 
weather systems. These systems can vary in   intensity from slight turbulence to dangerous 
thunderstorms. Traveling at high speeds,   pilots must be prepared at all times 
to alter the flight path if necessary. If, for example, they see a 
thunderstorm on the radar,   they must first get the OK from air traffic 
control (ATC) to change their route. Clear air turbulence is another worry, and 
because it cannot be seen on the radar,   pilots rely upon the information provided by 
pilots flying the same route ahead of them. When   flying across oceans such as the Atlantic, one 
pilot's job is to communicate with the ATC while   the other monitors a common air-to-air frequency 
that pilots use to communicate with each other. The entire time a flight is 
in the air, the pilots monitor   all kinds of gauges to ensure that the 
plane performs how it is supposed to. Making sure that the temperature of the fuel 
is not too cold is another thing pilots must   monitor. If the fuel cools down too much, 
its flow can be restricted due to waxing.   If this happens, pilots can rectify 
the situation by descending, or by   increasing the aircraft's speed (and, 
thus, its skin temperature). However,   this isn't a particularly frequent occurrence, 
as engine oil helps fuel to retain heat. While one of the pilots monitors all the 
gauges, the other will be busy taking care   of the paperwork. Before the flight, the 
pilots are given a written flight plan.   Anything that deviates from this 
must be written down as notes. Outside of these important activities, 
long-haul flying can be very boring for pilots.   During cruise phases, pilots will often pass 
the time by making small talk with one another,   or doing some reading. Smartphone games and 
good old fashioned crossword puzzles might be   additional forms of entertainment 
found on the flight deck. Finally, just like passengers, 
enjoying inflight meals   is another part of the long-haul pilot experience. The pilots typically wait until the passengers 
have been served and then eat separately.   They do this so that there is 
always one person at the controls. For long flights over twelve hours, there 
are one or two relief pilots onboard   so that the two pilots who performed the 
takeoff can take a break and get some rest. There are just two pilots on shorter 
long-haul flights of eight or nine   hours. The only opportunity they get to 
leave their seats and stretch their legs   is when they go to the bathroom. Did you know about these long-haul duties and 
activities? Let us know by leaving a comment.

reviews.transcript_full: Sweeten, Finding und Service auf höchsten Niveau. Genau das erwartet uns heute auf unserem mehr als zehnstündigen Nachtflug von Los Angeles nach Zürich, der Swiss First Class. Doch wird sie ihrem Ruf als eine der besten [musik] First der Welt wirklich gerecht, finden wir es heraus. Auch die schönste Hawaii Reise neigt sich irgendwann dem Ende zu. Und auch wenn wir das besondere Lebensgefühl der Insel jetzt schon vermissen, gibt es keinen Grund traurig zu sein. Denn für unseren Rückflug nach Deutschland wartet noch einmal ein echtes Highlight auf uns. Es ist unser erster Flug in der Swiss First Class und ich bin wirklich gespannt, ob sie den hohen Erwartungen gerecht werden kann. Swiss ist übrigens die einzige mir bekannte Airline weltweit, die in jedem einzelnen Langstreckenflugzeug eine Firstglass verbaut hat. Und allein das macht das Produkt schon besonders. Einen solchen Flug dann mit Meilen zu buchen ist allerdings fast unmöglich, es sei denn, man besitzt den Senatorstatus. Wie wir trotz den zwei der begehrten Plätze in den vorderen Reihen ohne Status ergattern konnten, erzähle ich dir später im Video. Geflogen wird die Strecke zwischen Los Angeles und Zürich mit einer Boeing 777300 ER. Insgesamt betreibt Swis 12 dieser Flugzeuge, die seit 2016 nach und nach eingeflottet wurden. Unsere Koffer sind schnell abgegeben, doch das Beste kommt erst noch. Ein Mitarbeiter eskortiert uns persönlich bis zur Sicherheitskontrolle und führt uns direkt an den wartenden Passagieren vorbei. Das ist schon wirklich besonders. Nach der Pass und Sicherheitskontrolle erreichen wir den Abflugbereich und ich muss schon sagen, dieses Terminal beeindruckt mich immer wieder. Bis zum Abflug haben wir noch ja so gute 2 Stunden Zeit und die Starlines betreibt hier eine eigene Lounge und bietet sogar an einem separaten Bereich exklusiv für First Class Passagiere einen Platz. Natürlich kommt dieser Bereich nicht an das Firstlass Terminal der Lufthans in Frankfurt heran. Dennoch erwartet ich hier ein angenehm abgeschämmter Sitzbereich mit eigenem Service, eleganten Sesseln, viel Ruhe und genügend Abstand von dem ganzen Trugel des Flughafens. Dazu gibt es hochwertige Snacks, eine gut bestückte Bar, erlesene Weine und auch Champagner, von dem ich uns direkt einmal gleich zwei Gläser zum Anstoßen einschenke. Solltest du Appetit auf etwas warmes haben, kannst du außerdem Gerächte direkt aus der Karte bestellen. Ich war natürlich neugierig, was die Küche zu bieten hat, wollte mir aber dennoch genügend Platz für das Essen noch am Bord lassen. Deshalb haben Katarina und ich uns gemeinsam ein Lachs bestellt und geteilt. Die Firstlass Lounge ist übrigens direkt über eine Schiebetur mit der Business Lounge verbunden. Besonders bekannt ist diese für ihre große Außenterrasse mit dem Blick auf das Vorfeld und die musste ich natürlich einmal anschauen. So, Katharina und ich machen uns gerade auf dem Weg zum Gate und Ja, die Lounge, die war echt schön. Gutes Essen, man sitzt da ganz nett, sehr freundlicher und so vorkommender Service. Also hier kann man ein bisschen Zeit verbringen und ja, jetzt bin ich aber natürlich gespannt, was die Swiss First Class zu bieten hat, gerade im Vergleich zu unserem Flug mit Lufthan auf dem Weg nach San Francisco und ja, ich freue mich auf jeden Fall, dass ich gleich dir das Ganze zeigen kann. Wir sneaken uns an den anderen Passagieren vorbei und steigen durch die erste Tür auf der linken Seite ein, wo wir bereits herzlich von der Crew begrüßt werden. Und der erste Eindruck der Kabine: Ich bin begeistert. Insbesondere im Vergleich zur Lufthan First Class in der Boeing 747, mit der wir auf unserem Hinflug nach San Francisco unterwegs waren. Das Video kannst du dir gerne im Vergleich ansehen. Mein Platz für die Nacht ist 2A. Nachdem ich meine Jacke in der Garderobe verstaut habe, schaue ich mich erst einmal etwas genauer um. Am Sitz warten bereits ein großes Kissen sowie das Amenity Kit auf mich, dass ich dir später noch zeigen werde. Kurz darauf bringt mir die Flugbekleiterin auch schon mein Pyjama für die Nacht. In diesem Sinne erst einmal Cheers auf einen hoffentlich großartigen Flug. Das Ambiente der Kabine und die verwendeten Materialen gefallen mir ausgesprochen gut. Alles wirkt modern, hochwertig und gleichzeitig angenehm wohnlich. Lass mich dir kurz einige Highlights dieses Sitzes zeigen. Unter dieser Abdeckung befindet sich die Fernbedienung für das Inflight Entertainment, die Kopfhörer sowie die Bedienelemente, mit denen sich der Sitz individuell einstellen lässt. Auch die indirekte Beleuchtung der Ablage ist ein schönes Detail, insbesondere auf Dachtflügen. Lediglich eine Möglichkeit zum kabellosen Laden des Smartphones fehlt hier. Das Herzstück des Sitzes ist jedoch der 32 Zoll große Bildschirm, der mit einer sehr guten Bildqualität überzeugt. Der Sitzabstand ist, wie soll es auch anders sein, mehr als üppig. Besonders spannend ist aber der zusätzliche Sitzplatz auf der Automane gegenüber, auf dem deine Begleitung während des Fluges gemeinsam mit dir essen kann. Das zeigen wir dir später. Jacken, Mäntel oder ein Sako lassen sich übrigens auf einem Bügel in der persönlichen Garderobe direkt am Platz verstauen. So, während der Kapitän die Passagiere über die Lautsprecher begrüßt, werfe ich bereits einen neugierigen Blick in die Menü und Getränkekarte, die ich dich hier gerne einmal einblende. information. Schönen guten Abend. Kurz darauf geht es auch schon los. Während die Sicherheitsdemonstration über die Bildschirre läuft, setzen wir uns langsam in Bewegung und rollen hinaus zur Startbahn von Los Angeles. Wenige Minuten später dann heben wir ab und steigen hinauf in den Nachthimmel über Kalifornien. Vor uns liegen nun 10 Stunden und 40 Minuten Flugzeit bis nach Zürich. Zu Beginn des Videos hatte ich dir bereits erwähnt, dass die Swiss First Class mit Meilen nur unter ganz bestimmten Voraussetzungen hochwe ist. Um überhaupt Zugriff auf diese begehrten Sitze zu behalten, benötigst du nämlich den Senatorstatus bei Worn. Unsere Flüg in die USA hatte ich bereits rund ein Jahr im voraus gebucht und der ursprüngliche Plan war eigentlich mit dem Lufthan Airbus A380 zurück nach München zu fliegen, was ebenfalls auch eine großartige Story gewesen wäre, denn Hinflug in der 747, Rückflug im Airbus A380. Doch im vergangenen Sommer paste der Lufthanse dem Flugplan dann an und tauschte den A380 gegen einen Airbus A350 aus, allerdings ohne First Class. Also begann die Suche nach einer Alternative und glücklicherweise konnten wir die Flüge online umbuchen und dabei die Swiss First Class auswählen. Rückblickend war das also ein absoluter Glücksgriff. Mittlerweile haben wir uns Reiseflughöhe erreicht und es wird Zeit in etwas bequemeres zu schlüpfen. Also schnappe ich mir mein Pyjama und mache mich auf dem Weg zum Waschraum. Für die acht Passagiere der First Class stehen im vorderen Bereich der Kabine gleich zwei Waschräume zur Verfügung. Das ist mal ein ziemlich komfortables Verhältnis, wie ich finde. Die Bilder selbst sind zwar nicht außergewöhnlich groß, bieten aber ausreichend Platz zum Umziehen. Darüber hinaus findest du hier feinste Pflegeprodukte von Sisley. Zurück an meinem Platz verstaue ich meine Kleidung ordentlich in der Garderobe und schaue anschließend, was das Inflight Entertainment so zu bieten hat, bevor dann der Service beginnt. Der Bildschirm hat eine angenehme Größe und überzeugt mit einer guten Auflösung. Kein Vergleich zur Lufthansa. Also das gesamte Inflight Entertainment lässt sich bequem über die Fernbedienung steuern. Besonders praktisch, während der Filmläuft, kannst du dir parallel die Flugrute oder andere Informationen anzeigen lassen. Kurz darauf beginnt auch schon der Service. Zum Aperativ bleibe ich meinem Favoriten Treu und stoße mit einem Glas Louise auf den Flug an. Dazu wird ein kleiner Gruß aus der Küche serviert. Ich bin bei solchen Amusgos ehrlich gesagt immer ein bisschen skeptisch. Nicht, dass ich am Ende doch irgendwo wieder einen Pilz versteckt. Ich hatte da nämlich schon mal ein traumatisches Erlebnis. Dann beginnt endlich das Dinner. Der Tisch wird liebevoll eingedeckt und ich denke mir in diesem Moment, wenn das Essen genauso gut schmeckt, wie der Service bisher herzlich und aufmerksam ist, dann wird uns dieser Flug definitiv in Erinnerung bleiben. Schon das Setup gefällt mir ausgesprochen gut. Ein großer Tisch, ein reich gefüllter Brotkorb, Butter, Ausstrich sowie edle Salz und Pfeffermühle. Genauso stelle ich mir ein Firstlass Dinner vor. Die Vorspeisen werden Stelecht direkt am Silvierwagen präsentiert. Das absolute Highlight ist für mich der Baliklachs. Schaut dir allein mal die Farbe und die feine Marmorierung an. Serviert wird er mit Gleinies und Saur Cream. Dazu entscheide ich mich noch für ein Pännchel Orangensalat mit roter Zwiebel und einer gebratenen Jakobsmüchtel. Der Balik Lax ist übrigens eine Schweizer Spezialität und gilt als eine der besten Räucherlachse der Welt. Damit hätte ich ehrlich gesagt nicht gerechnet. Wusstest du das? Als nächstes folgt eine Sellerie Apfelrahmensuppe mit weißen Trüffel und geräucherter Ente. Wunderschön angerichtet und geschmacklich ein Volltreffer. Für den Hauptgang stehen vier Gerichte zur Auswahl. Entweder kurz gebratener Wolfsbusch, Hähnchen mit Barbecussoße, gegrilltes Kräutersitlinge oder eine Rinderfilet. Meine Wahl fällt natürlich auf das Rinderfilet, begleitet von einem kräftigen Rotwein aus Südafrika. Das Fleisch ist perfekt gegart, wunderbar zart und wird zusammen mit einen Krat aus Okinava Süßkartoffeln und Butternskürbis serviert. Auch wenn ich inzwischen wirklich mehr als satt bin, für ein Dessert gibt es bekanntlicher immer einen extra Marken. Und ich teide mich für Babaoorum, einen rum getränkter Naptkuchen mit fruchtiger Orange und einer feinen Konditorcreme. Dazu begleitet von einem kräftigen Espresso mit einer kleinen, aber feinen Pralinenauswei aus dem Hause Sprüngli. Dann genieße ich noch die letzten Minuten meines Films. Mittlerweile sind wir über 3 Stunden unterwegs und die Kabine ist inzwischen komplett abgedunkelt. Die meisten Passagiere schlafen bereits. Damit wird es auch für mich Zeit schlafen zu gehen. Unsere Flugbekleiterin verwandelt meinen Sitz innerhalb weniger Augenblicke in ein richtig gemütliches Bett. Für einen erholsamen Schlaf gibt es eine dicke Matratzenauflage, zwei bequeme Kissen und eine kuschelige Bettdecke. Mit einer Liegefläche von rund 2 m Länge und knapp 60 cm Breite sollte so einer entspannten Nacht über dem Atlantik eigentlich nichts mehr im Wege stehen. In diesem Sinne, gute Nacht. Wir sehen uns morgen früh wieder. Ein neuer Tag beginnt und ich muss sagen, ich habe wirklich gut geschlafen. Zwar war es in der Kabine etwas warm, doch Schlafmaske und Ohrstöpsel haben genauso gute Dienste geleistet wie die bequeme Matratzenauflage und die hochwertige Bettwäsche. Während ich noch langsam wach werde, bringt mir die Flugbegleiterin bereits ein warmes Tuch. Bis zur Landung in Zürich bleiben noch gut zwei Stunden. Genau die richtige Zeit für ein ausgiebiges Frühstück. Doch dieses Mal esse ich allerdings nicht alleine, denn während wir das Abendessen jeweils an unseren eigenen Plätzen genossen haben, möchten wir nun eine der schönsten Funktionen der Swiss First Class ausprobieren. Gemeinsam an einem Tisch frühstücken. Dafür wird der Ottomane gegenüber kurzerhand zweiten Sitzplatz umfunktioniert und wir können den Morgen gemeinsam beginnen. Los geht es mit einem frischen Obstsalat, einer kleinen Auswahl an Aufschnitt und natürlich einem gut gefüllten Brotkorb. Und unsere ätherischen Öle dürfen natürlich ebenfalls nicht fehlen. Wenn du auch wissen möchtest, wie sie dir das Reisen angenehmer machen können, findest du den passenden Link unten in der Videobeschreibung. Für Katharina gibt es einen Cappuccino, für mich eine Tasse Kaffee und dazu einen frisch gepressten Orangensaft. Als Hauptgang entscheiden wir uns für Avocado Toast mit einem Ei und ein paar Würstchen. Das Frühstück ist schön angerichtet und schmeckt hervorragend. Und weil ich bei Süßschweißen einfach nicht widerstehen kann, bestelle ich zusätzlich noch einen Pancake mit Bären. Aber ganz ehrlich, was soll das denn sein? Optisch konnte er mich schon nicht überzeugen und leider hat er auch genauso geschmeckt, wie er aussah. Kurz nachdem unser Tisch abgeräumt wurde, überrascht uns die K noch mit einem kleinen Abschiedsgeschenk. Feinste Pralin von Sprüngli und dazu eine handgeschriebene Karte mit persönlichen Zeilen unserer beiden Flugbekleider. Ich liebe Schokolade und genau solche kleinen Gesten machen einen Flug am Ende wirklich besonders. Jetzt, wo wir uns bereits im Landeanflug befinden, möchte ich dir noch einen kurzen Blick in das Amenity geben. Darin findest du verschiedene Pflegeprodukte von Sisley, einen angenehm dicke Schlafmaske sowie Zahnbürsten und Zahnpasta. Die Verpackung wirkt sehr hochwertig und elegant. Der Inhalt ist gut, haut mich persönlich aber nicht komplett vom Hocker. Während die Kabine für die Landung vorbereitet wird, tausche ich nun den gemütlichen Pyjama wieder gegen meine normale Kleidung. Kurz darauf empfängt uns die Schweiz mit besten Februarbeter. Nach der Landung am Doc werden alle Firstlass Gäste persönlich vom Botenpersonal begrüßt und empfang genommen und im Anschluss mit einem Mercedes Sprinter direkt zum Terminal A gefahren. Ein wirklich angenehmer Service, denn so spart man sich den Weg mit der Flughafenbahn und umgeht gleichzeitig den großen Trubel an einer Passkontrolle. So, weiterflug nach Hamburg bleibt nicht mehr allzu viel Zeit. Für einen kurzen Besuch in der Swiss First Class Lounge hier im Terminal A reicht es aber trotzdem noch. Die Lounge bittet eine stilvolle Bar, einen kleinen Alcatbereich sowie eine gute Auswahl an Exon Getränken. Besonders gut gefallen hat mir das Alpine Desesign mit den vielen kleinen Sitznischen, das eine angenehm ruhige und gemütliche Atmosphäre schafft. Mit einem letzten Glas Champagner und ein paar Oliven lassen wir diese wunderschöne Reise langsam ausklingen. Die Swiss First Class hat unsere Erwartung in vielen Bereichen sogar übertroffen. Vor allem die herzliche Cuh, das hervorragende Catering und das insgesamtstümmige Gesamterlebnis macht diesen Flug zu einem Produkt, das wir jede Zeit wiederbuchen wollten. Ich hoffe, dir hat dieser Flug genauso viel Freude bereitet wie uns. Wenn dir das Video gefallen hat, freue ich mich über einen Daumen nach oben und natürlich über ein Abo, damit du keine unseren nächsten Reisen verpasst. Bis zum nächsten Mal. Mach's gut und bis bald.

Das war so weit mit der kleinen Vorstellung des Orics Entertainment Systemen hier.

reviews.transcript_full: Schauen wir uns das nächstes einmal das Infotamin System an, das hier verbordet ist, das ORIX Entertainment,  welches eine Vielzahl von Unterhaltungsmöglichkeiten bietet.  Das System lässt sich hier wieder über den Tatsschrien steuern oder über diese Fernmedinung.  Das muss man aber allerdings am Anfang, wenn das System gebrutet ist, einmal selber auswählen.  Also ob man die komplette Menüfführung hier möchte oder dort.  Ich habe es jetzt dort gewählt, weil es für mich einfacher ist, aber man hat hier auch den Mauszeiger,  mit dem man hier im Prinzip weitergehen kann und durch das Menüß scrollen kann.  Ich würde es euch jetzt aber einmal am Bildschirm zeigen.  Wir gehen einfach mal durch die Optionen, zum Beispiel hier oben, ganz aindeutig die Sprache auszuwählen.  Man kann sich hier verschiedene Wiedergabe-Listen anlegen, welche Filme sehr herin oder Musik man noch hören möchte.  Hier oben finden wir Infos zu verbleibenden Flugzeite, 5 Stunden, 9 Minuten.  Dort kommen wir direkt auf die Reine im Saftzeige, wo wir eine Übersicht erhalten, wo wir uns gerade befinden.  Die Ansicht wechselt dann einmal zwischendurch.  Und sonst finden wir hier nochmal die Flugnummer und von Wunafo, wo wir fliegen.  Beginnen wir einmal mit den Hauptmenübungen.  Einmal Tipp des Monats, die aktuellen Heilheits-Affelmeilheits, die hier im System verbaut sind.  Dort kommen wir wieder überhaupt zurück.  Dann kommen wir hier einmal auf TV.  Hier finden wir alle TV-Siehren, die aktuell sind neue an Bord.  Hier kann man sich auch dramer an Neuernbord oder alle Dokumentationen, was auch immer das Herz begehrt.  Hier kann man sich hier durchwählen und anschauen.  Dann kommen wir immer weiter zu den Spielen.  Hier haben wir was Schüssehwase Golf, Infleit, Pac-Man.  Backgämmen, Shanghai, sag mir jetzt nichts.  Karts, okay, wir sind ja auch Sport.  Also per eine Menge an Spielen und aus der Färmendienung wird dann quasi einen Controller.  Weiter geht's mit der Landkarte.  Die haben wir eben schon hier drüber aufgerufen.  Denn was besonders hier im A350 ist die Kamera, die sich oben am Wien befindet.  Die aber ja, da wir ein Nachtflug haben, ich entschuldige mich ja noch mal für die Qualität.  Ja, kann man es leider nicht besser darstellen.  Dort haben wir einmal die Konnektivitäten, WLAN.  Man kann sich hier ganz einfach verbinden und hat WLAN.  Also man muss nichts weiter dafür tun.  Also ganz easy.  Alportverbindung kann man hier direkt über die USB-Fnitz-Schleppe anschließen.  Und dort auch durch drüber wiedergeben über die Boardanlage oder Bilder wiedergeben.  Dann haben wir noch einen Punkt, Katarewitz.  Hier finden wir einfach Informationen über Katarewitz.  Also Katarewitz sind Privilegschlub, den sie haben oder über Katar an sich einkaufen.  Katar-Exkutiv über Flughafen, Haltinfos rund um den Flughafen.  Dann kommen wir jetzt zum letzten Punkt auf dieser Seite einmal zum Shopping.  Hier könnt ihr euch halt durch verschiedene Einkaufsmöglichkeiten klicken.  Geben noch einmal die andere Seite.  Hier finden wir das Entertainment.  Noch einmal die Filme.  Eine aktuelle Forschauer, was demnächst läuft.  Und ich könnte euch einfach einfach in einem Sprach unter Deutsch die Filme anzeigen lassen.  Und die sind, weil ich das gesehen habe, auch nach Neuigkeit, sortiert.  Dann haben wir hier noch einmal Musik.  Hier könnt ihr euch auch, wie gesagt, wir sind obere Menüner regieren.  Und zu den verschiedenen Alben kommen, anwählen und einfach wiedergeben.  Und hier könnt ihr das entsprechend von einer zuhause Wiedergabeliste hinzufügen.  Eine letzte Punkt, Katarewitz ist ganz schön gestaltet.  Wir finden die gleichen Sobode wieder.  Nur eben etwas Kindlicher gestaltet.  Und eben noch nur die Auswahl für Kinder enthalten.  Das war so weit mit der kleinen Vorstellung des Orics Entertainment Systemen hier.  Am Board der Katarewitz A350.  Unter das System ist sehr gut gefallen.  Die Bildqualität von den Filmen ist sehr gut.  Die Wiedergabel hier in der Business Class ist sehr gut.  Ich zeige euch dazu noch einmal den Kopfhörer.  Es ist ein an neues Kennenzlingen-Kopfhörer, den wir hier haben.  Es ist leider sehr schwer zu sehen.  Der schöne Orpholz hat die sehr gute Amoer auf.  Oder wird es nicht am Orp legen, das ist ein ordentliches Kopfhörer.  Und das ist sehr angenehm, diesen zu tragen.  Und der drückt auch nicht bei längerem Flug.

reviews.transcript_full: Hello and welcome to Chicago Hair International Airport.  Today you'll join me on a business class journey to Munich aboard Lufthansa's A350.  This flight is part of my return trip between Vienna and Chicago, initially booked an economy  for 751 euros, then upgraded using e-vouchers from my mouse and more senator's status.  Unlike Austrian Airlines and Swiss, which operate out of Terminal 5, Lufthansa shares Terminal  1 with United Airlines.  We arrived at the airport just before 5pm, only to discover that the check-in desks wouldn't  open until 10 past 6.  Anticipating this, we queued up at 550 as the staff began to appear and the desks opened  slightly ahead of schedule.  Check-in and priority security were remarkably efficient and we found ourselves at the  sea gates in no time.  Traveling through O'Hare's iconic tunnel, a brief 3-minute walk brought us to the highlight  of our early arrival, the United Polaris Lounge.  Exclusively available to international, star alliance, business or first class passengers,  the Polaris Lounge offers the finest lounge experience in Chicago.  Even if your flight departs from a different terminal, you can switch terminals airside  to indulge in this unparalleled oasis of comfort and luxury.  Feeling hungry, we bypassed the drinks counter and the inviting seating pods and headed straight  for the dining room, the Allacard restaurant of the lounge.  While reservations are possible during busy times, we were fortunate to find the lounge  almost empty, securing a table immediately.  The menu, though small, was perfectly curated.  In a business class lounge, quality over quantity is key and a limited selection ensured each  dish was of top-notch quality.  We settled into a cozy booth with a view of the dining area and enjoyed a delightful meal.  I opted for the signature burger, customizable with a variety of toppings and it exceeded  my expectations.  For those in a hurry or seeking a quick snack, the expansive buffet offers a variety of options.  The lounge also features a manned bar for alcoholic beverages.  As a huge fan of cocktails, I eagerly ordered an old-fashioned but was disappointed by how  overly sweet it was.  I decided to switch to champagne for the rest of our stay, which proved to be a much better  choice.  It's worth noting that the bar expects you to tip, which I find a bit off-putting in  a lounge setting.  The lounge provides excellent apron views, though there wasn't much activity to observe  during our visit.  As our time in the lounge drew to the close, we learned that the showers and nap rooms  were already closed as well, which was a minor disappointment.  However, the all-gender restrooms were plentiful, spacious and impeccably clean, adding to  the overall comfort of our lounge experience.  After a delightful stay in the lounge, we made our way back through the tunnel and headed  to the B gates, where two Lufthansa flights, one to Frankfurt and our Sumeunik, were scheduled  to depart from neighboring gates in quick succession.  These convergence created a somewhat chaotic scene, with passengers crowding the area.  However, when priority boarding commenced, we swiftly left the crowd behind and joined  the queue to board our aircraft, an Airbus A350-900.  The A350 features eight rows in a 2-2-2 business class configuration.  The larger cabin spans rows 1-2-6, while a more intimate mini cabin occupies rows 7-8.  For this flight, we selected Seats 7 Hotel and 7 Kilo in the bulkhead row of the smaller  cabin, seeking a bit more privacy.  We were warmly greeted at the door, and again, as we made our way down the aisle, but unfortunately,  that was the extent of the warm hospitality we had anticipated.  Currently, the most common business class product in Lufthansa's fleet is starting to see  a change with the introduction of their new Aliegris business class, which debuted on  the Munich-Tubank Uber route on May 1, 2024.  While this older configuration is certainly outdated and lacks privacy, it does offer an  advantage for couples like us who enjoy sharing a window seat.  Here's a clear view of row 8, along with a look at the bulkhead footwell, which was  unfortunately smaller than I had hoped for.  However, this was not the biggest issue I encountered with the seat.  More on that later.  We had ample time to settle in, as the crew assigned to our cabin was noticeably absent.  It wasn't until long after the left side of our cabin had been served the welcome drinks  that we were finally offered a glass of champagne.  Let's take a closer look at the seat.  Unfortunately, there are no individual air vents.  The aisle seat offers a bit more storage space than the window seat, thanks to the litter  richer pocket positioned between the footwells.  The closed cubby initially housed the amenity kit and a water bottle.  Head folds outwards in the middle.  Between the seats there are two universal power outlets.  The whole next to them housed the AKG on ear headphones and the headphone jack.  On top of the consoles are the controls for the air cushioned seat and a flap opens up  to reveal the tray table and IFE remote.  Underneath the console is a USB-A port.  The tray table is released by pushing on it and folds out to double the surface area.  Although there was some flex, it felt sturdy overall.  The remote uses a D pad instead of the cursor found on other Loftanza planes.  My left armrest could be lowered to widen the bed or make it easier to leave the seat  with the table deployed.  The headrest which also houses a reading lamp is adjustable as well.  Here you can see the amenity kit, a pouch from Portia design containing the bar essentials  and a few lotions from Lotsitun.  Next to the IFE screen there is a coat hook and a holder for your glasses.  After take off the meal service began with a hot towel.  As is typical with overnight flights from the US, the selection was somewhat limited and  the meal was served on one tray to save time.  If you're eager to get to sleep you can opt for the Express service.  Nuts were handed out with the drink service.  For my main course I chose the surf and turf which was easily the best dish I enjoyed  on this flight.  The appetizer salad wasn't too my liking but the ice cream provided a satisfying conclusion  to the meal as I decided to skip the cheese course.  The restroom was a standard A350 bathroom featuring a full body mirror and a few amenities  stocked on the counter.  In addition to soap there was also lotion available.  As for the seats they are slightly angled towards the fuselage unlike the bulkhead.  The IFE screens fold out slightly but unfortunately cannot be angled downwards when you're in  bed mode which can't be inconvenient.  The entertainment selection was just okay.  I found a few movies that caught my interest but frequent flyers might quickly exhaust the  available content.  The user interface worked well with the remote but the limitations of the system became  apparent when trying to scroll with a finger.  The TV show selection was a significant letdown.  While waiting for the flight map to load I checked out the Wi-Fi prices.  25 euros gets you unlimited data with the highest speed for the entire flight.  The plane is equipped with three cameras providing different views during the journey.  Lufcans are offers unpackaged headphones for their business class customers with ear  pad covers available in the amenity kit.  As usual I opted to use my AirFlight Pro Bluetooth transmitter in conjunction with my AirPods  Max.  Before bed the crew handed out a small box of pre-leens a delightful touch to end the evening.  As I mentioned before the seat is air cushioned theoretically allowing you to adjust the firmness  of the mattress.  Unfortunately an hour after I managed to fall asleep I awoke with hip pain because the  bottom half of the seat had completely deflated leaving me lying on the metal frame.  The crew had to partially disassemble the seat to check all the hoses and restart it.  Luckily this fixed the issue but it still disrupted my sleep.  Unlike on other long haul flights to Asia for example no mattress pads slippers or sleeping  shirts were provided on this flight.  Breakfast was served on a single tray which was perfectly fine.  The Greek yogurt bowl was into my liking but the rest of the breakfast dish was okay.  I was left a bit underwhelmed by this flight.  The crew member attending to us throughout the journey neither greeted us nor smiled during  any interaction.  It is heartening to feel like a burden to the crew especially when you are being friendly  and not making any special requests.  The entertainment selection was lackluster which isn't a huge deal for a night flight  but it could be a let down on day flights or for frequent flyers who get the same limited  selection.  The food was okay though I can't be somewhat picky so I might not be the best benchmark  in that regard.  The issue with the seat in bed mode was unfortunate but thankfully could be fixed.  I had a similar issue on Swiss a few years ago and that persisted throughout the whole  flight.  Our flight to Chicago in Austrian Airlines business class was much more enjoyable.  If you have the option I would recommend choosing them over Loftanza.  You can see what that flight was like by clicking on this video.  Thank you so much for watching, please like and subscribe if you're new, happy travels  and see you soon.

Finally the passion fruit and mango tart at the end were superb, really sweet and a terrific finish to a very good meal.  One of the things I really liked about the entertainment system is the interactive way finding with cities that you pass over.  It's a bit like travel inspiration on the move.  Oh and as well as a good selection of entertainment there's a handy guide to the service flow on the flight which is helpful for setting expectations.  Not everyone in business class flies it all the time and this is good for infrequent flyers.  This flight takes about 11 hours but as it departs so late and arrives in the evening in Singapore after 5pm, having a short sleep is actually fairly sensible. Landing is at just after 5pm.  Anyway another hot towel down and the second meal service is breakfast served at 4pm local time in Singapore.  It was great actually, it's just not perfect to have a breakfast so late in the day.  Oh and before I forget here's Finneur's rather beautiful Maddie Mercot and Menitiquette.  A different one to the one I had on the New York flight and this one is a really striking design.  Overall a really solid experience.  Finneur is a splendid airline with great ground services and a fine business car product on the A350.  It would be great if they introduced a down on demand or something similar on these strange routes where not everyone will want breakfast or dinner at a set time.  This really helps you adjust your desired time zone.  But aside from that this was a great flight and an experience I definitely repeat. reviews.title: ¿cómo es viajar de MADRID a SHANGHAI en TURKISH económica ? ✈️19:45 horas
reviews.transcript_excerpt: Amigos, una nueva crónica de vuelo, en este caso para ir de Madrid, a Shanghai, con conexión…
reviews.transcript_full: Amigos, una nueva crónica de vuelo, en este caso para ir de Madrid, a Shanghai, con conexión  en Istanbul. Esta rolinia seguirá teniendo un instante armedio alto o habrá caído,  a Oante, Turquish.  Señor Espasajeros, bienvenidos a bordo de Antonio por viajes, antes de sus inturones  que vamos a enterrizar.  Primero, Madrid es tan buen. El humtres tres, un árbuz tres veintiúna, tiempo de vuelo  de este primer tramo, cuatro horas y quince minutos.  Esto es lo que se retina el asunto en el tramo madrido, Istanbul.  Y despacio para las piernas jústitos. Terminó la fácil del vein y se están repartiendo  a todas las cúmeras calientes. Es bastante bueno la bolla caezas. Sujeta bastante bien.  Como es un vuelo corto, cuatro horas quince, la aproximadamente no van auriculares. Cada  uno se los tiene que traer. Si se piden, consiguen, pero no reparten a todos los pasajeros.  A la hora de iniciar el vuelo, el armoarzo, que había dos opciones, la záña, o algo  de carne. Lo que Andréán no puede desifrar, que es esto salado, es una crema salada  con que no sabemos. Después viene el bicochuelo, agua y nosotros hemos pedido vino, además  un pancito y los cubiertos son de acero inóxitable. El baño es un pelín más grande que otros,  pero siempre del tamaño estángar.  Aero puerto de Istanbul, como estamos en tránsito, no hacemos migraciones nada.  Directamente, nos dirigimos a la nueva puerta de embarque. Como tenemos casi cuatro horas  todavía de conexión, nos venimos a una de las salas. Andréán que busque lugar, acá, perfecto.  El acceso a estas salas alrededor del mundo está incluida en nuestra tarjeta de crédito,  para que los hombres puedan orar. Aquí hay una mezquita para hombres, uno de los tanipos baños  aquí, por sus pasillos. Llegamos por las puertas A y ahora nos toca salir por las puertas  D y cambiamos de piso. Y acá esta zona está concurrida. Sabéis que hay bastante público.  Volvemos a bajar las puertas D están abajo. Muchas casas de comida rápida y cafeterías  de cadenas internacionales. Auriculares, la mantita y la modita. Eso es lo típico.  El necesario de este viaje contiene por un lado tenemos cepillo de dientes,  más que para los oídos y después tenemos zapatichitas, pantuflas, pantuflas, arremedio, calcetines,  indelindo y tapah ojos. Eso es lo que contiene el necesario en este vuelo de turquish de  tambúl a Shanghai. Y el tiempo estimado de vuelo de este segundo tramo es de 10 horas y 20 minutos.  Miramos, un posapio. Está bueno. No hay muchos aviones que tengan posapio.  Bolcitas especial para los chicos. Buen detalle. También tiene todas las instrucciones con  lenguaje de señas. Con esto se puede llamar a la ociidia recabina, pero en el valúso de la ciento  y también se puede seleccionar algún fuego y jugar con él porque tiene un tecladito atrás.  Ahora está en cabecer a depistas en este momento. Recuerden que el despegue es una fase que demora  entre 10 y 15 minutos. Allá vamos.  Andrea está mirando el menú lo que va a ver para comer en un ratito.  Primero, el menú que hay parece ser que es lo primero que va a venir ahora en un ratito.  Tenemos carne con musaca o una tortilla de papás y queso o una ensalada de bollo, medita  reña parecida a la cesa. De postre una panacota. Nos dieron en este momento una actualista  húmeda caliente para poder limpiar las manos y la cara.  El baño grandecito. Hasta tiene tabla para cambiar paníales de bebés.  Miren, no se van a ver en los pies. Ahí estoy.  Grandecito. Bien.  El despacio para las piernas. Jutito.  Se reclina bastante. Están a punto de desarrollar la cena y previamente repartieron una botellita  de agua por cada pasajero. Y a la hora y 10 minutos de iniciar el vuelo sirven la cena.  Andrea pidió carne. Tiene con una saladita, un pasito, una salsa rara.  Y yo me pedí la ensalada medita reña. Siguien dando bien cubiertos de acero inoxidable.  Terminada de la cena. Van a servir de desayuno.  Eso será dos horas antes de finalizar el vuelo o sea que aproximadamente dentro de unas seis horas a partir de ahora.  Vine a un segundo año a mostrarselo. Pero no puedo. Este es más chico que es a monterrey.  Pero no puedo porque y me da mucha bronca. Algunos de mis congeles estuvo antes y rego la tabla del water.  No cuesta nada de mandarla.  Y a la hora 8 de iniciar el vuelo. El desayuno. ¡Ay, bien!  Subur un poquito de fruta y en mi caso Pancakes.  Andrea se pidió un omelette.  No se olvides de suscribirse a mi canal y totalmente gratis y activa la campanita para que les avise la publicación de mis próximos videos.  Muchas gracias.

reviews.title: IFE review - Inflight Entertainment System - Air India (Domestic A320 fleet)
reviews.transcript_excerpt: In this video, I will show you the details of the in-flight entertainment system available…

captions.text: In this video, I will show you the details of the in-flight entertainment system available
The IFE kept me busy on a 3 hour flight from day to day and the movie is that being played

reviews.transcript_full: In my previous video, I briefly reviewed the Business Class of An India's Airbus A319  aircraft, which you can see by clicking on the video now or clicking the link in the description  box.  In this video, I will show you the details of the in-flight entertainment system available  on their Airbus fleet for domestic sectors.  The Business Class VTV is 10.6 inches in size and is touchscreen.  The IFE starts in the map mode wherein it toggles between the flight details screen,  the airline logo screen and the map screen in three different zoom levels.  Touching the mode button on the screen brings you to the video mode where 6 movie channels  are displayed.  This unfortunately is a non-Award system which I believe is a norm for short-haul flights  these days.  The on-screen touch controls give you an option of changing channels, volume and brightness  of the screen.  Touching the mode button again will switch off the video and take you to the audio mode  with the wide variety of audio channels choose from.  Press mode again and the map screen appears along with the music playing in the background.  There is also an option to change the aspect ratio of the screen if you are not a big fan  of 16s to 9.  All this can also be controlled by the hard button controls on your armrest.  The IFE kept me busy on a 3 hour flight from day to day and the movie is that being played  with a tradition.  Overall I would rate the IFE 4 out of 5 for short-haul flights.  It would have been a perfect 5, 100 been an Award system just how they have on their long  haul-buying aircraft.  Please leave a comment below and do check out the other videos.  Also don't forget to subscribe.  Thank you.

article_quotes.text: New GUI and actual 4K shine in Cathay’s A321neo Panasonic IFE - Runway GirlRunway Girl New GUI and actual 4K shine in Cathay’s A321neo Panasonic IFE - Runway Girl Runway Girl Network uses cookies.

Some nine years after Panasonic Avionics first introduced 4K inflight entertainment touchscreens via the Waterfront concept at CES , the hardware and content pipeline has finally brought 4K aboard an aircraft I’ve flown.

Your author recently experienced his first actual, real-world 4K video on board a Cathay Pacific A321neo this month, in conjunction with Cathay’s launch of 4K HDR content last month (for which, full disclosure, he was a guest of the airline), and the experience was an absolute joy.
Content service provider, Anuvu, started providing 4K content to Cathay’s A321neo aircraft in 2021 .

It feels like this could use a card sort exercise or some other categorisation work, perhaps separating the lighting and crew call buttons from the IFEC control and status buttons, with consistent button size.
With an empty seat next to me, I was able to try out the Watch Together function.

Image: John Walton The content library was overall wide-ranging, with 4K HDR content limited to a fairly small selection of films, most of which are classics like The Godfather , Shawshank Redemption , and The Lord of the Rings , with some praiseworthy Hong Kong classics included as well.

Image: John Walton Cathay executives told RGN during a follow-up interview that the blocker to more 4K content is upstream of the airline, with the content owner, content service provider and IFE system provider not yet working well enough together for a wider library of 4K content.

reviews.title: How Safran Passenger Innovations drove weight out of nextgen IFE - Runway GirlRunway Girl
reviews.transcript_excerpt: Also driving weight savings is a decision by SPI to tuck a lightweight DC power system into the seat leg to power its RAVE Ultra plus 13.3″ displays in economy class and provide up to 60W of USB charging per passenger.

article_quotes.text: How Safran Passenger Innovations drove weight out of nextgen IFE - Runway GirlRunway Girl How Safran Passenger Innovations drove weight out of nextgen IFE - Runway Girl Runway Girl Network uses cookies.

Safran Passenger Innovations (SPI) has enjoyed an impressive trajectory in embedded inflight entertainment and today is seen as delivering proverbial ‘Cadillac’ IFE systems to airlines around the globe.

And a joint ideation project between SPI and Lufthansa led to the launch of new docked companion tablets that enable Allegris business class passengers to control their IFE, seat functionality, lighting and thermal environment with the device.
But SPI is also focused on what it says is a more sustainable approach to embedded IFE.

And so, when it set about to design its next-generation system, it didn’t just adopt new display and processor technology — 4K miniLED HDR 10+ Liquid Crystal Displays for the former and Snapdragon for the latter — it also worked to slash weight to reduce CO2 emissions.

Also driving weight savings is a decision by SPI to tuck a lightweight DC power system into the seat leg to power its RAVE Ultra plus 13.3″ displays in economy class and provide up to 60W of USB charging per passenger.

SPI also developed a product that allows AC power in economy to be selected as an option, explaining thusly: “The solution is deployed by distributing AC power directly to AC outlets located in every seat from a small number of power distribution points located throughout the cabin.

For example, below each 13.3″ display sits what Asmar calls “the little pill at the front” which features the USB ports and the audio socket, presently available in four combos (including USB-A and/or USB-C).

yt_comments.text: Really enjoyed this video, especially Dan's dad and his business class experience. TK actually does have aircraft with a more up-to-date and much more private seating in business. I think they're gradually phasing out the 2-3-2 seats that are so un-private. That being said, TK is my favorite for business class USA to Europe: the chef, the FOOD, overall service, IFE, the lounge in IST. What I definitely don't like is the enormous size of the IST airport and the interminable walking. Thanks for the tip about an alternative passageway through the airport.

yt_comments.author: @hanjiongmiao6067
yt_comments.text: As a Chinese avgeek growing up in Shanghai, it’s great to hear you enjoyed your flight on China Eastern. After all, it is the airline I grew up flying. About the livery, they do used to have a nicer looking old livery which had already been completely phased out favoring the more “modern looking ” white one. Few notes about their product, about the Wi-Fi, you are actually suppose to enter a access code purchased online as a economy passenger (or something like that), free access code is only given to businesses and first class. The game section had apparently been disabled for cost cutting reasons. The USB charging port also often don’t work on their 777 so be aware!

yt_comments.author: @bembs0256
yt_comments.text: I flew China Eastern Airlines last month from Jakarta to Shanghai on a A330-200. It was a pretty good flight. We had a slight delay, but they managed to land in Shanghai on time. The crew was kind and helpful (they managed to find my lost left earbuds! 😂) Also, the food was FANTASTIC! One of the best in-flight meals I’ve ever tasted, after Thai Airways and Garuda Indonesia! The only drawback was the IFE. Yes, the system was pretty dated, and the movie selections were basic. Also, they DIDN’T provide us with headphones! I thought they forgot to provide headphones on our flight to Shanghai, but no, they also didn’t provide headphones on our return flight to Jakarta! 😓 Also, I saw a flight attendant walking back and forth with a camera attached on her chest. Although it didn’t really bother me, but yeah, it was quite odd. 🤔 Overall, it was a pretty good flight. Not the best flight I’ve ever had, but considering its cheap price, heck, I would fly with them again (but this time, PLEASE don’t forget the headphones)!

yt_comments.author: @actuallyfims
yt_comments.text: Took for the first time with China Eastern a month ago from Singapore to Seoul with a layover at Shanghai. My expectation going into this was low but everything exceeded my expectations. Price was very cheap at 380SGD return flight and comparing with Singapore's budget airline Scoot which was selling at 500SGD although a direct flight, China Eastern was far more worth it. The price includes 2x 23KG check in, full meal service on all the flights totaling to 4, in-flight entertainment although i agree the content is lacking but wasn't a big deal as i slept thru out the entire flight. Legroom was enough on the B737 while big enough on the A330, the A350 has a slightly larger legroom. Food was good as well.

yt_comments.author: @anthonywalsh2164
yt_comments.text: Very similar service and IFE to China Southern, though the cabin is nicer in MU, very boring in CZ. Also the transit and airport experience in PVG are remarkably similar to those in CAN.

chapters.title: Why does Brisbane need a metro?

reviews.transcript_full: Hello and welcome to Brisbane! When we think of a metro, we often associate it with rapid transit train systems like the Sydney Metro, London Underground, or Singapore's MRT. Today, Brisbane is launching its own metro, though it's not what you might expect from the name. Let's go and take a closer look! Since September 2000, Brisbane has developed a Bus Rapid Transit (BRT) network, mainly through the construction of dedicated busways that run separately from regular traffic. These exclusive corridors have enhanced the efficiency and reliability of bus services, encouraging more residents to opt for public transportation. As a result, the city’s bus infrastructure quickly reached capacity in a number of areas and has led to congestion on some bus routes and at key interchanges. To address this, in 2016, the Brisbane City Council proposed the Brisbane Metro. Initially, the plan was to convert the busway from Woolloongabba to Herston into a track-based, rubber-tyred underground metro system similar to the Paris Metro. However, by March 2017, while keeping the same name, the project shifted to using high-capacity bi-articulated buses on the existing busway, reducing costs by $500 million. And this becomes the Brisbane Metro we see today! The first stage of the Metro consists of two routes covering 21 kilometres. Metro 1 will replace bus routes 111 and 160, connecting Eight Mile Plains to Roma Street with 11 stations. Metro 2 has 12 stops and will replace route 66, linking the Royal Brisbane and Women's Hospital to the University of Queensland. The system will utilise the existing busways and was initially designed to offer turn-up-and-go services with three-minute intervals during peak times, though this was later scaled back to every five minutes. Full services for Metro 1 and Metro 2 are expected to commence by the end of the year. Today, Brisbane Metro is having a soft launch, running between UQ Lakes and Eight Mile Plains, replacing some regular buses on route 169. The 60 buses ordered for Brisbane Metro are built by the Swiss manufacturer HESS and are similar to the models operating in Basel, Switzerland, and Nantes, France. Each bus has three large double doors for efficient boarding, including one automated on-request ramp access at the first passenger door. Before we hop on board, do you know what this is for? Brisbane Metro buses are battery-electric and rely on charging facilities to operate. This is one of the end-of-route flash charging locations on the network, where each bus uses a pantograph that autonomously connects to the charger, recharging the bus in just six minutes. At the Rochedale Metro depot, slower overnight chargers are used to enhance battery lifespan and optimise energy efficiency. At 24.7 metres long, each bus can carry 150 passengers in comfort mode or up to 170 in event mode. There are three accessible spaces at the front with next stop audio and hearing loops in all compartments. As you'd expect from a modern bus, there are WiFi and USB charging ports throughout, along with real-time travel information screens. Brisbane-born actress Melanie Zanetti provides the voice for Brisbane Metro. The expected cost to deliver Brisbane Metro is $1.4 billion. It will reduce around 125 buses from the CBD during the morning peak while maintaining passenger capacity. Route 169 serves nine stations. Thanks to the dedicated busway, what typically takes 28 minutes by car in regular traffic only took 20 minutes on the metro. Overall, I found the ride enjoyable. It's more flexible than a tram line while offering similar capacity, making it the next best alternative to the original rubber-tyred metro design. Given that most people associate "metro" with trains, I do believe names such as Brisbane Electric Rapid Transit (BERT) would be more fitting for this new public transport option. Thank you so much for watching! If you find this video interesting, please hit the like button and subscribe to my channel for more train and flight reviews. See you all in my next video!

At the front are 10 business class car seats in a 22 configuration with three rows on the right side of the cabin and two on the left side. Each seat has a pitch of 37 in and a width of 23.9 in, which is quite comparable to the Quantis Bone 737 business seats, but with a more modern touch. The economy class is arranged in a 32 configuration. All standard seats have a pitch of 30 in.
